messages:
Anna: Quick Q — where do I find the panels for GPU SM% vs KV cache hit rate and batch-size correlation? Need these for a short postmortem and to tune alerts. Anyone have dashboard links or panel ids? :thinking_face:
Ben: There's a Grafana folder called 'Observability / GPU Inference'. Dashboard id 8M2bG. SM% panel name is 'gpu_sm_util', KV hit is 'kvcache_hitrate'. I can drop direct panel links in a sec.
Carlos: Panel links: https://grafana.company/d/8M2bG/gpu-inference?viewPanel=3 (SM%) and https://grafana.company/d/8M2bG/gpu-inference?viewPanel=7 (KV hit). Use time range last 6h to see recent evictions.
Dan: For traces, use Tempo: https://tempo.company/search?query=service:inference%20env:prod. Filter spans by tag 'kv.cache' to surface KV-related evictions. Logs live in Loki: {job="gpu-runtime"} |= "kvcache evict".
Ellie: On alert tuning — current KV eviction alert is 5% over 2m and it's noisy for canaries. Suggest 10% for canary groups, keep prod at 5% with 3m window. SM% alert currently fires at >88% for 1m; maybe increase to 90% for non-prod. @Ben can we add canary overrides?
Ben: Yep, I can add an alert template that supports per-pool overrides. Will open a PR in infra-monitoring and tag the alert owners. Branch: kvcache-alerts-adjust.
Anna: Thanks — one more: any quick tip for overlaying batch-size histogram with SM% so I can correlate spikes?
Carlos: Use two queries in Grafana: A=avg(rate(gpu_sm_util[1m])) by (instance) and B=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, instance)). Put A on left axis, B on right, set time to 6h. There's an example panel in the dashboard (panel 12). I can send a screenshot if helpful.
Dan: Quick Loki snippet to find large batches in logs: {job="gpu-runtime"} | json | batch_size > 32. That lets you pull the exact requests that caused larger batches.
Ben: I'll post the PR link here once it's up and ping @Anna for review. :thumbsup:
